opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Aplicación Web Multiempresa para Gestión de Remunerac...
opportunities.description: Se busca un equipo o desarrollador para crear una aplicación web robusta y segura destinada a una firma jurídica especializada en asesoría de remuneración flexible para empleados. La plataforma debe ser multiempresa, permitiendo el ingreso con roles diferenciados y asegurando el aislamiento de datos entre cada firma. Los módulos clave incluyen: - Ingreso multiempresa con gestión de roles y datos aislados. - Carga masiva de datos de empleados y remuneración desde archivos Excel/CSV, con validaciones integradas para asegurar la integridad de la información. - Configuración de parámetros por empresa, incluyendo proporción de remuneración, menú de beneficios, elegibilidad y reglas vigentes. - Un simulador individual que compare el esquema de remuneración actual con el propuesto, asigne cupos de beneficios y muestre detalles como salario, aportes, retención, ingreso neto, efectivo disponible, beneficios restringidos y ahorros mensuales/anuales. - Generación de reportes individuales en formato PDF/Excel y reportes consolidados. - Un sistema de auditoría completo para registrar cargas, modificaciones, simulaciones y aprobaciones. La firma proporcionará presentaciones y capturas de un simulador anterior como referencia funcional. Es fundamental que las reglas jurídicas y fórmulas, definidas por la firma, sean configurables, versionables y diferenciadas para salario ordinario e integral. Se prefiere el uso de tecnologías como React/TypeScript para el frontend, ASP.NET Core (.net 10 lts) para el backend y postgresql como base de datos, aunque se considerarán alternativas bien justificadas. Dada la naturaleza de los datos (personales y salariales), la seguridad es primordial, requiriendo aislamiento por empresa, permisos por rol, cifrado de datos, auditoría exhaustiva y respaldos regulares. El alojamiento de la aplicación debe ofrecer una tarifa mensual fija, sin cobros automáticos basados en el número de usuarios, simulaciones o consultas, ni autoescalado. Se deberá especificar la capacidad, límites, costo de respaldos y posibles cargos adicionales. La propiedad del código fuente, el acceso al repositorio, las cuentas de despliegue y toda la documentación técnica deben ser transferidos a la firma al finalizar el proyecto. Se solicita incluir en la propuesta la experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones multiempresa, un cronograma detallado y una cotización separada por fases de desarrollo, costos de alojamiento y mantenimiento. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: High Volume Google Flow Video Production
opportunities.description: I am scaling a new YouTube network and need a large pool of creators who can generate finished videos directly inside Google Flow. opportunities.title: GST Software Assistant Needed
opportunities.description: I’m working with a Chartered Accountant on a new GST software and I need an extra set of hands for about 15 hours each week. Your core responsibility is simple: complete whatever weekly task the CA assigns. Most weeks this centres on GST rules and logic—verifying calculations in spreadsheets, cross-checking return formats, spotting edge-case scenarios, or sanity-testing new modules in the app. You can log in whenever you wish, as long as the assignment is finished before the next weekly stand-up. For the first two months I’ve budgeted ₹10,000 per month; once we are into full release we can revisit the arrangement. Deliverables (each week) • The task or set of tasks provided by the CA, fully executed and documented • A short summary outlining what you did, any GST-related insights, and bugs or anomalies discovered Good communication over email or WhatsApp and basic familiarity with GST return workflows will make the collaboration smooth. Everything is remote, so a reliable internet connection is all you need to get started.

opportunities.title: Contenido TikTok Rehabilitación LCA Hogar
opportunities.description: Quiero convertir la guía de rehabilitación de ligamento cruzado anterior en piezas breves, claras y motivadoras que funcionen en TikTok. El público son personas de cualquier edad con cirugía reciente, así que el lenguaje debe ser sencillo y sin tecnicismos. Alcance del trabajo • Desarrollar un calendario de publicaciones con guiones de 1-2 minutos y textos de apoyo pensados para TikTok (formato vertical, ritmo ágil y dinámico). • Dividir la información en tres grandes etapas: primeras semanas, meses 2-3 y meses 4-6. • Mostrar ejercicios seguros explicados paso a paso como eje principal: calentamiento, rango de movimiento, fortalecimiento y propiocepción, siempre sin equipamiento especial. • Incluir señales de alerta para saber cuándo parar y consultar al médico. • Añadir consejos prácticos de vida diaria (dormir, subir escaleras, uso de calzado, transporte, etc.). • Cerrar cada pieza con recordatorio de que la información es educativa y no sustituye la opinión profesional. Entregables 1. 15 guiones de video (Word o Google Docs) con indicaciones de plano, texto en pantalla y voz en off. 2. 15 textos cortos acompañantes (150 - 200 caracteres) listos para publicarse como descripción y hashtags sugeridos. 3. Un esquema visual por fase que resuma los ejercicios mostrados, útil para futuras infografías. 4. Documento de referencias científicas básicas que respalde la información. Tono y estilo Amable, alentador y empático. Uso de frases breves, emojis moderados y llamadas a la acción que inviten a seguir la serie completa de videos. Para evaluar tu propuesta, comparte ejemplos de trabajos similares: guiones, reels o hilos sobre salud, deporte o temas médicos explicados de forma accesible. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y ajustar detalles antes de comenzar.

opportunities.title: Game-Ready Sci-Fi Spaceship Model
opportunities.description: Project Overview: Looking for an experienced 3D Hard Sci-Fi Artist to create a production-ready, highly detailed cargo vessel spaceship from scratch. I have built a complete proxy/blockout model combining various reference parts to establish exact scale, proportions, clearance, and key functional features. You will use this reference model strictly for dimensions, spatial logic, and layout alignment, but the final mesh, details, and textures must be created 100% from scratch. Key Technical Requirements & Constraints: 1. Cockpit & Design Logic: - No Windows: In line with realistic hard sci-fi physics (radiation shielding), the cockpit has zero windows/glass. Visual navigation relies entirely on external camera arrays embedded in the hull structure. - Scale & Head Shape: Must maintain the general shape, scale, and exact dimensions of the reference model. - Bottom Gate: The cockpit’s lower entry gate must match the reference model's exact width, height, and ground clearance. 2. Landing Gear & Thruster Setup: -Partially Retractable Gear Mounts: The ship uses an existing, separate, fully animated partially retractable landing gear asset. The mounting bases on the new hull must match the reference distances and maintain exact ground clearance. -Leg Base Thrusters: Exactly 5 directional/maneuvering thrusters built into each leg base mounting point, matching the layout on the reference model. -Main Engine: A single main engine thruster centered on the rear hull, following a design language similar to the reference. 3. Hull Features, Docking & Armaments: - Side Loading Docks: Two functional loading docks situated on the left and right sides of the main hull at approximately the same position as in the reference model, featuring hydraulic magnetic arms similar to the example. - Underside Dock Bays: Two additional docking bays located on the bottom/underside of the hull, aligned vertically at the same longitudinal position as the left and right side docks. - Civilian/Industrial Spec (No Weapons): The vessel must NOT feature any weapons, hardpoints, guns, rocket pods, or combat mounts. It is purely an industrial/civilian cargo ship. - Branding Panels: Clean, high-visibility flat/curved hull surface areas reserved on both sides for large logo placement. - Overall Scale: Small aesthetic design tweaks are welcome, but overall vehicle dimensions must remain practically identical to the reference proxy. 4.Art Style & Hard Sci-Fi Realism: - Grounded, industrial, hard sci-fi aesthetics (heavy structural plating, realistic panel seams, optical camera housings, wear logic). - No recycled textures or stolen/modified base meshes from the provided proxy. Complete original mesh and PBR material setup. Deliverables: - Clean low-poly game-ready mesh. - Source files (.fbx) aligned properly to world origin (X=0, Y=0, Z=0). - PBR texture maps (ORM packed preferred; 4K texture sets). - Clean high-poly baking source mesh or trim sheet setups used. Contract Terms & Intellectual Property: By accepting this contract, you agree that upon full payment, all custom 3D models, source files, textures, and deliverables are 100% original work and will become the exclusive property of the employer for commercial use. How to Apply: Please submit: 1. A link to your portfolio highlighting hard sci-fi vehicles, mechanical props, or industrial hard-surface 3D models. 2. Your primary software workflow (e.g., Blender, Maya, Substance Painter, Marmoset). 3. Estimated turnaround time and bid/rate for this scope. Note: A Blender (.blend) file containing the example reference/proxy model will be provided upon reaching an agreement.

opportunities.title: Selldone Store Setup & Automation
opportunities.description: My Selldone account already has the skeleton of a mechanic-tool store, our logo set, and a clean CSV containing roughly 500 SKUs. I now need someone who can take it from “starter” to fully operational. Here is what I expect you to handle: • Import and neatly organise all 500 products from my CSV, including category structure, photos, and variant data already embedded in the file. • Establish an automated daily sync from the supplier’s FTP so every product field—stock, price, images, descriptions, categories—stays current without manual touch-ups. • Configure shipping so checkout is restricted to the continental United States (lower 48 only; no Alaska, Hawaii, or overseas). • Point two domains to the same store: one will serve as the primary URL, the other should 301-redirect to it. Both domains are already parked under the same Selldone account; they just need correct DNS and Selldone settings. The initial framework, brand colours, and some basic pages are in place, so your focus is purely on data import, automation, domain tweaking, and shipping rules. I will give you: – The current Selldone login. – The FTP credentials and file path for the nightly feed. – Logos, colour codes, and any missing product images. Please be comfortable working inside Selldone’s product manager, CSV mapper, shipping zones, and DNS configuration panels. Once complete I should be able to wake up each morning to a store that is perfectly synced, indexed, and ready to ship only within the lower 48. If you have done similar e-commerce data jobs—especially on Selldone or comparable SaaS platforms—let me know and include one live example.

opportunities.title: Build Morning Fuel’s Premium Brand Identity
opportunities.description: # Brand Identity, Logo Design & Product Packaging Design for Morning Fuel ## About Our Brand Morning Fuel is a modern, new-age healthy food and snacking brand focused on making everyday nutrition convenient, enjoyable, and appealing. We aim to build a distinctive, premium, and recognizable brand that connects with today's generation, young consumers, and working professionals. Our product range includes oats, muesli, date bites, nuts, seeds, and other healthy snacking products. We are currently preparing to launch our brand and are looking for a creative designer who can help us establish a strong visual identity from the ground up. We want Morning Fuel to become a recognizable brand in the healthy food and snacking category, with a consistent visual language across all our products. ## Project Overview We are looking for an experienced freelance brand identity and packaging designer who can help us develop the complete visual identity of Morning Fuel and design attractive, professional packaging for our products. We are interested in working with an individual designer who has a strong creative vision, understands modern branding, and can translate our ideas into a distinctive brand identity. We are not looking for just a standalone logo. We want to develop a complete brand identity that works consistently across different products, packaging formats, and flavours. ## Scope of Work ### 1. Logo Design - Create a unique, memorable, and recognizable logo for Morning Fuel. - Develop a logo that represents a modern, new-age healthy food brand. - Explore creative concepts and typography-based logo options. - Ensure the logo works across different packaging sizes and formats. - Provide primary and secondary logo variations where appropriate. - Deliver final logo files in high-resolution and editable formats. ### 2. Brand Identity and Visual Language - Develop a complete visual identity for Morning Fuel. - Establish a suitable brand colour palette. - Select typography and fonts that complement the brand personality. - Define supporting visual elements, graphic patterns, icons, and design elements where appropriate. - Create a consistent visual language that can be applied across all products. - Provide basic brand guidelines explaining logo usage, colours, typography, and other visual elements. ### 3. Product Packaging Design We need attractive, modern, and commercially practical packaging designs for our healthy food products. Our planned product categories include: - Oats - Muesli - Date Bites - Nuts and Seeds - Other healthy snacking products The initial focus will be on selected products from these categories, with the possibility of expanding the product range in the future. The packaging should look premium, modern, clean, and visually appealing while clearly communicating the product name, flavour, and relevant product information. We want a consistent packaging system in which all products belong to the same brand, while different product categories and flavours remain easy to identify. The designer should be able to adapt the main packaging design to additional flavours and variants without losing the overall brand identity. ### 4. Packaging Mockups and Print-Ready Files - Provide realistic 3D packaging mockups to help us visualise the final products. - Prepare print-ready packaging artwork according to the printer's specifications and approved dielines. - Ensure the artwork is suitable for commercial packaging production. - Provide editable source files and final export files. - Coordinate the design with the available packaging dimensions and technical specifications. Packaging dielines and dimensions will be discussed and finalised according to the selected packaging formats. ## Our Design Vision Morning Fuel is a modern, new-age brand. We want our identity to feel fresh, distinctive, premium, youthful, and memorable. We appreciate thoughtful typography, balanced colour combinations, clean layouts, creative packaging concepts, and strong visual consistency. We are open to creative ideas and suggestions from the designer. We want someone who can bring their own expertise and help us create a visual identity that stands out in the competitive healthy food market. The final design should be attractive both on physical retail shelves and in online product listings. ## Ideal Freelancer We would prefer a designer who has experience in: - Brand identity and logo design. - Food and beverage branding. - FMCG product packaging design. - Healthy food, snacks, cereals, or nutrition-related brands. - Typography, colour theory, and visual identity systems. - Packaging mockups and print-ready artwork. Experience with food brands and multi-product packaging systems will be an advantage. ## Expected Deliverables Depending on the agreed scope, the project deliverables should include: 1. Logo concepts and final approved logo. 2. Primary and secondary logo variations, where applicable. 3. Brand colour palette and typography selection. 4. Visual identity elements and design system. 5. Basic brand guidelines. 6. Product packaging designs for the agreed initial products. 7. Packaging adaptations for agreed flavours and variants. 8. Realistic product packaging mockups. 9. Print-ready packaging files. 10. Editable source files for the completed designs. The exact deliverables, number of concepts, revision rounds, and number of packaging variants will be agreed upon before the project begins. ## Budget and Proposal Requirements We are a new brand preparing for launch, so we are looking for a designer who can offer creative, high-quality work at a reasonable and suitable price. Please submit your proposal with the following details: - Your portfolio of previous branding and logo design projects. - Examples of food or FMCG packaging you have designed. - Your proposed approach for Morning Fuel. - A clear price breakdown for logo design, brand identity, and packaging design. - Your pricing for additional product variants. - Estimated project timeline. - Number of initial concepts and revisions included. - Confirmation of the editable source files and commercial usage rights included in your package. Please mention whether you can offer a combined package for brand identity and packaging design. We are interested in building a strong, long-term brand and would love to work with a creative designer who understands our vision and can help bring Morning Fuel to life. If you have relevant experience and believe you can help us create a distinctive brand identity, we look forward to reviewing your proposal and portfolio.

opportunities.title: CNC Milling Program for Steel Part
opportunities.description: I have a CNC milling machine ready to cut a new steel / stainless-steel component, but I still need a clean, production-ready program generated from my drawing / 3D model. Your task is to translate that design into reliable G-code, verify it with proper simulation, and supply any supporting setup information so the part can go straight to the machine with no surprises. What I will provide • The 3D model (STEP) and a fully dimensioned PDF drawing. • Notes on preferred tooling already in our shop. What I need back • Optimized G-code for a standard Fanuc-style controller (please tell me if you prefer Mastercam, Fusion 360, SolidCAM, or similar—any of those are fine as long as the output runs fault-free). • A tooling list with speeds, feeds, and coolant calls. • A brief setup sheet showing zero locations, workholding, and any special offsets. • Verification screenshots or report proving the simulation is collision-free. Acceptance The program must finish the part complete in one setup, maintain the tolerances called out on the print, and leave a surface finish suitable for light deburr only. If anything needs clarification, let me know right away so we can keep this moving quickly.

opportunities.description: TOMEC busca comercial freelance B2B para el sector industrial | Retribución por resultados En TOMEC, empresa de ingeniería especializada en automatización industrial y logística, buscamos incorporar un colaborador comercial freelance para desarrollar nuestra cartera de clientes. Trabajamos en proyectos de automatización, programación PLC, robótica, sistemas de transporte y clasificación, soluciones AMR/ACR y optimización de procesos logísticos, con experiencia en proyectos para grandes empresas como Amazon y otros clientes industriales. ¿Cuál será tu misión? - Identificar empresas industriales con necesidades de automatización. - Contactar con gerentes y responsables de ingeniería, operaciones, mantenimiento y logística. - Generar oportunidades comerciales y concertar reuniones. - Realizar el seguimiento de las oportunidades hasta el cierre de las operaciones, con apoyo técnico de nuestro equipo. ¿Qué buscamos? - Experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B. - Capacidad para captar clientes y abrir nuevas cuentas. - Se valorará especialmente la experiencia comercial en automatización industrial, ingeniería, robótica, intralogística o servicios técnicos. - Autonomía, iniciativa y orientación a resultados. ¿Qué ofrecemos? - Colaboración freelance, sin exclusividad inicial. - Modelo de remuneración basado en resultados, con comisiones vinculadas a las operaciones comerciales. - Apoyo técnico y comercial de TOMEC. - Posibilidad de desarrollar una colaboración estable y ampliar progresivamente el volumen de negocio. Buscamos una persona que sepa abrir puertas en el sector industrial y convertir oportunidades en negocio. Si tienes experiencia comercial B2B y te interesa colaborar con TOMEC, envíanos tu perfil y una breve descripción de tu experiencia, los sectores en los que trabajas y los resultados comerciales que has conseguido.

opportunities.description: PROJECT: COMPLETE OFFLINE DESKTOP APPLICATION FOR ETT ADMINISTRATIVE AUTOMATION Maximum fixed budget: €300. We are a Spanish temporary employment agency (ETT) looking for a developer to build a complete desktop application to automate our administrative workflow for employees assigned to companies in France. We are not looking for a demo, prototype or basic example. We want the complete application described below, with all the requested processes integrated into one working system. The maximum budget available for this project is €300. Please only submit a proposal if you are willing to work within this budget. 1. EXISTING SOFTWARE AND ACCESS We can provide access to our existing systems: - NominaSOL: We already use this software and can provide access so you can inspect how it works, particularly its Social Security functionality and certificate-based operations. - Amin: This website belongs to our company. We also have a copy of the website available for technical inspection. - We can provide document templates and examples of our current administrative paperwork. We want you to investigate these systems and use available integration methods wherever technically possible. 2. DESKTOP APPLICATION We require an offline-first desktop program installed on our computer or authorised local infrastructure. Requirements: - Desktop graphical interface. - Local database and document storage. - No Google Drive dependency. - Employee management and individual files. - Automated workflow management. - PDF generation and document merging. - Secure handling of employee information. - Complete source code and installation instructions. Local employee management and document processing must work without cloud storage. Internet access will be required for external online operations. 3. EMPLOYEE DOCUMENT PROCESSING AND OCR Our commercial department receives NIE/passport documents and employment information through WhatsApp. The application must allow document uploads and use OCR to extract: - First name and surname. - NIE / identification number. - Expiry date. - Date of birth. - Nationality. - Address, postcode, city and province. - Country and place of birth. - Passport information, where available. Employment start date, French client company and contract duration must also be recorded. Extracted information must be reviewable and editable. 4. EMPLOYEE DATABASE The application must create and maintain individual employee records. It must detect duplicates, reuse existing employees and preserve previous employment assignments and historical documentation without overwriting earlier files. 5. SOCIAL SECURITY AND NAF The application must support NAF consultation using employee identification details and automate the relevant process through the available authorised Social Security integration. It must also process employee registrations through Sistema RED, using the relevant employee information, NAF, start date, Social Security regime and employer CCC. The system must record official responses and clearly distinguish confirmed registrations, rejected operations, pending operations and errors. We can provide NominaSOL access so you can investigate how its existing Social Security connection works. 6. AMIN AND CONTRACT DOCUMENTS The application must connect with our Amin environment where technically possible. It must search for existing employees, reuse their records or create new ones, and generate: - Employment contracts. - Mission contracts (contrat de mission). - CPD documentation, where applicable. Generated documents must be saved as PDFs in the corresponding employee file. You can inspect our Amin website and the copy we own to determine the best integration method. 7. FRANCE POSTING AND A1 The application must manage the information required for employees posted to France, including employee details, Spanish employer information, applicable Social Security regime and CCC, French client company, workplace address and assignment dates. We want the A1 application process automated through the available authorised channels. If online submission fails, the system must save the error or submission receipt and support the alternative manual procedure, including TA300 documentation where applicable. The application must distinguish between an A1 application prepared, submitted, pending, rejected and an officially issued A1 certificate. 8. SIPSI AND FINAL DOCUMENTATION SIPSI information and documentation must be organised within the employee file. The declaration itself may be completed manually if no authorised integration is available. The application must generate and organise the final documentation package, allow PDFs to be merged and prepare the employee file for delivery to the French client. 9. USER INTERFACE We require a clear interface with: - Employee search and database. - Individual employee files. - New employment assignment. - Document upload and OCR. - Social Security and NAF status. - Amin document status. - A1 status. - SIPSI status. - PDF generation and merging. - Error and pending-operation notifications. 10. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS We are open to your recommended technology. Python/PySide6, SQLite, Tesseract OCR and PDF libraries are possible options. The application must include local storage, basic logging, error handling and backup functionality. All credentials and digital certificates must be handled securely. We will not provide unrestricted access to real certificates or passwords. 11. DELIVERABLES The project must include: - Complete working desktop application. - All requested workflow modules. - Source code. - Installation instructions. - Database structure. - Basic user documentation. - Rights to use and modify the delivered application. Any external integration must be genuinely implemented and tested. Do not describe an operation as automated if it still requires manual execution. 12. FREELANCER PROPOSAL Please explain how you would implement the complete project within our maximum budget of €300. Tell us about your experience with desktop applications, OCR, PDF automation, databases, browser automation and integrations with business software. We can provide access to NominaSOL, our Amin environment and sample documents to help you understand the existing workflow. We are looking for a developer capable of delivering the complete application, not just a visual prototype.

opportunities.title: Brand Identity, Logo Design & Product Packaging Design for "Morning Fuel"
opportunities.description: # Brand Identity, Logo Design & Product Packaging Design for Morning Fuel ## About Our Brand Morning Fuel is a modern, new-age healthy food and snacking brand focused on making everyday nutrition convenient, enjoyable, and appealing. We aim to build a distinctive, premium, and recognizable brand that connects with today's generation, young consumers, and working professionals. Our product range includes oats, muesli, date bites, nuts, seeds, and other healthy snacking products. We are currently preparing to launch our brand and are looking for a creative designer who can help us establish a strong visual identity from the ground up. We want Morning Fuel to become a recognizable brand in the healthy food and snacking category, with a consistent visual language across all our products. ## Project Overview We are looking for an experienced freelance brand identity and packaging designer who can help us develop the complete visual identity of Morning Fuel and design attractive, professional packaging for our products. We are interested in working with an individual designer who has a strong creative vision, understands modern branding, and can translate our ideas into a distinctive brand identity. We are not looking for just a standalone logo. We want to develop a complete brand identity that works consistently across different products, packaging formats, and flavours. ## Scope of Work ### 1. Logo Design - Create a unique, memorable, and recognizable logo for Morning Fuel. - Develop a logo that represents a modern, new-age healthy food brand. - Explore creative concepts and typography-based logo options. - Ensure the logo works across different packaging sizes and formats. - Provide primary and secondary logo variations where appropriate. - Deliver final logo files in high-resolution and editable formats. ### 2. Brand Identity and Visual Language - Develop a complete visual identity for Morning Fuel. - Establish a suitable brand colour palette. - Select typography and fonts that complement the brand personality. - Define supporting visual elements, graphic patterns, icons, and design elements where appropriate. - Create a consistent visual language that can be applied across all products. - Provide basic brand guidelines explaining logo usage, colours, typography, and other visual elements. ### 3. Product Packaging Design We need attractive, modern, and commercially practical packaging designs for our healthy food products. Our planned product categories include: - Oats - Muesli - Date Bites - Nuts and Seeds - Other healthy snacking products The initial focus will be on selected products from these categories, with the possibility of expanding the product range in the future. The packaging should look premium, modern, clean, and visually appealing while clearly communicating the product name, flavour, and relevant product information. We want a consistent packaging system in which all products belong to the same brand, while different product categories and flavours remain easy to identify. The designer should be able to adapt the main packaging design to additional flavours and variants without losing the overall brand identity. ### 4. Packaging Mockups and Print-Ready Files - Provide realistic 3D packaging mockups to help us visualise the final products. - Prepare print-ready packaging artwork according to the printer's specifications and approved dielines. - Ensure the artwork is suitable for commercial packaging production. - Provide editable source files and final export files. - Coordinate the design with the available packaging dimensions and technical specifications. Packaging dielines and dimensions will be discussed and finalised according to the selected packaging formats. ## Our Design Vision Morning Fuel is a modern, new-age brand. We want our identity to feel fresh, distinctive, premium, youthful, and memorable. We appreciate thoughtful typography, balanced colour combinations, clean layouts, creative packaging concepts, and strong visual consistency. We are open to creative ideas and suggestions from the designer. We want someone who can bring their own expertise and help us create a visual identity that stands out in the competitive healthy food market. The final design should be attractive both on physical retail shelves and in online product listings. ## Ideal Freelancer We would prefer a designer who has experience in: - Brand identity and logo design. - Food and beverage branding. - FMCG product packaging design. - Healthy food, snacks, cereals, or nutrition-related brands. - Typography, colour theory, and visual identity systems. - Packaging mockups and print-ready artwork. Experience with food brands and multi-product packaging systems will be an advantage. ## Expected Deliverables Depending on the agreed scope, the project deliverables should include: 1. Logo concepts and final approved logo. 2. Primary and secondary logo variations, where applicable. 3. Brand colour palette and typography selection. 4. Visual identity elements and design system. 5. Basic brand guidelines. 6. Product packaging designs for the agreed initial products. 7. Packaging adaptations for agreed flavours and variants. 8. Realistic product packaging mockups. 9. Print-ready packaging files. 10. Editable source files for the completed designs. The exact deliverables, number of concepts, revision rounds, and number of packaging variants will be agreed upon before the project begins. ## Budget and Proposal Requirements We are a new brand preparing for launch, so we are looking for a designer who can offer creative, high-quality work at a reasonable and suitable price. Please submit your proposal with the following details: - Your portfolio of previous branding and logo design projects. - Examples of food or FMCG packaging you have designed. - Your proposed approach for Morning Fuel. - A clear price breakdown for logo design, brand identity, and packaging design. - Your pricing for additional product variants. - Estimated project timeline. - Number of initial concepts and revisions included. - Confirmation of the editable source files and commercial usage rights included in your package. Please mention whether you can offer a combined package for brand identity and packaging design. We are interested in building a strong, long-term brand and would love to work with a creative designer who understands our vision and can help bring Morning Fuel to life. If you have relevant experience and believe you can help us create a distinctive brand identity, we look forward to reviewing your proposal and portfolio.

opportunities.description: I have lost access to my own WhatsApp account and need a security professional who can guide me—step by step—through recovering it and locking it down so this doesn’t happen again. The job is strictly for legitimate account-owner recovery: no attempts to breach anyone else’s data or violate WhatsApp’s terms of service. I will supply proof of ownership (phone number, SIM information, past backup details) as soon as we start. Your role is to: • Diagnose why the account is no longer accessible (SIM swap, device change, forgotten PIN, possible hijack, etc.). • Coordinate the correct sequence of actions with WhatsApp Support—including any email templates or evidence packets—so the recovery request is approved quickly. • Walk me through two-step verification re-enablement, backup restoration, and post-recovery hardening (strong PIN, device checks, account security hygiene). Success is defined as me logging back into the account on my primary phone and confirming that messages, media, and contacts are intact, with two-step verification active. If you have proven experience recovering WhatsApp or similar messaging accounts, please outline a brief plan and estimated timeline in your proposal.

opportunities.title: Finance Shorts Automation Setup
opportunities.description: I’m building a new finance-focused YouTube Shorts channel and want the entire production line automated. The idea is simple: I paste a finished script into the workflow and, without any extra clicks, the system outputs a polished Short that I can upload the same day. Here’s what the pipeline must achieve for every video: • Once I drop the script in, the AI automatically creates the voice-over, on-camera visuals, captions, and delivers the final 60-second file ready for upload. • Each Short must use a realistic AI presenter who speaks directly to camera in a confident male voice, matching the energetic yet trustworthy tone common in this niche. I already have topic lists and reference “AI clone” examples, so your job is to handle the technical side—from choosing the right generation tools and templates to wiring them together so the process is as close to one-click as possible. If extra APIs, plug-ins, or custom scripts are required, please include setup and concise documentation so I can maintain the system myself after hand-off. At hand-over I expect: 1. A working automation workflow I can test by pasting a sample script. 2. Source files, presets, or code used to build the pipeline. 3. A short Loom or PDF walkthrough showing me how to run, tweak, and scale the process. If you’ve built similar “script-in, video-out” systems—especially for YouTube Shorts—let me know; examples will help me decide quickly.

opportunities.title: Update CAD House Design Drawings
opportunities.description: I already have the base .dwg files for my new house, but several aspects of the layout and detailing have changed since those were produced. I now need an AutoCAD specialist who can jump straight into the existing files, adjust room sizes and wall positions, revise doors, windows, and the stair arrangement, and then regenerate the elevations and sections so everything stays perfectly coordinated. These drawings are meant for internal review and visualization, so clarity and clean layering matter more than permitting notes. If you work in recent AutoCAD versions (I’m on 2024) and are comfortable keeping my current layer names, the job will move quickly. Deliverables • Updated floor plans in .dwg and PDF • Revised elevations and sections matching the new plan • All dimensions, annotations, and blocks cleaned up and consistent Once I receive the updated set, I’ll review, mark up any final tweaks, and we’ll close the file. If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Mobile AI File Search & Share
opportunities.description: I want a lightweight AI-driven mobile utility that can crawl every kind of file stored on the phone—images, videos, PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets, audio clips, you name it—and let the user surface the exact item they need by searching the content itself. The core requirement is content-aware search: a typed keyword that appears inside a document or a visual element detected in a photo should be enough for the tool to find the file instantly. File names alone are not reliable for my users, so optical character recognition and image object detection will be essential components. Once a file is located, the user must be able to share it straight away through WhatsApp and any other chat apps present on the device, with the original format preserved—no manual conversions or extra taps. Deliverables I expect • An Android (and, if feasible, iOS) app or installable prototype with on-device indexing and content search. • Fast, private processing; cloud calls are fine for heavy models, but storing personal files remotely is not. • A simple UI: one search bar, a results list with thumbnails/previews, and a native share sheet focused on WhatsApp first. • Demo video and source code so I can verify accuracy against mixed media test files. If you have prior experience combining OCR, vision APIs, or local vector databases on mobile, let me know—speed and minimal battery impact will decide the winner.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40794607, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 75,000 - 150,000.

opportunities.title: Promote Movie App on WhatsApp -- 2
opportunities.description: I have a new movie-streaming Android app ready to roll out and I need its link and promo poster placed inside real, active Indian WhatsApp movie and entertainment groups you already manage or actively participate in. For the initial run we’ll keep it small: just 3–5 groups so I can verify quality before scaling. What matters most for this test is clicks on the app link—no fake traffic, no forwarding to dormant or bot-filled lists. Every group you use must be genuinely active with Indian members chatting about films, trailers, actors, OTT releases, etc. The message and poster should stay in English, matching what most of those groups already recognise. Here’s how we’ll work: • You post the supplied poster and link in each agreed-upon group. • You send me a quick screenshot immediately after each post plus the WhatsApp group name so I can track timing. • I monitor the click report from my dashboard; once I see real traffic coming in from those groups, I release payment for each verified post or install—whichever we finalise before starting. If you’re based in India, actively involved in genuine movie/entertainment WhatsApp circles, and confident you can deliver authentic clicks, let’s run the pilot right away and build from there.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40794582, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Edición Dinámica para Videos Gaming
opportunities.description: Tengo un pequeño canal de videojuegos en YouTube y quiero llevar la edición de mis videos a un nivel mucho más profesional. Busco a alguien que domine un estilo dinámico con cortes rápidos, efectos y toques de humor que mantengan la energía alta de principio a fin. ¿Qué necesito? • Edición más profesional para mis videos, centrada en un ritmo ágil y entretenido. • Inclusión regular de: – Subtítulos animados que resalten mis frases y reacciones. – Efectos de sonido, zooms y transiciones rápidas para enfatizar momentos clave. – Memes, imágenes y clips de apoyo que conecten con la cultura gamer y añadan chispa. Cómo trabajaremos – Te entregaré el gameplay bruto junto con las indicaciones de los momentos importantes y cualquier referencia de estilo. – Espero un primer borrador breve para alinear tono y ritmo; después realizarías los ajustes finales. – El archivo final debe estar optimizado para YouTube (1080p , códec H.264, buen balance de audio). Si disfrutas transformando gameplays en contenido vibrante y lleno de memes, anímate a colaborar conmigo. ¡Hagamos que cada video atrape desde el primer segundo!

opportunities.description: Meta Business Verification & App Review Expert Needed — WhatsApp & Instagram API Approval for SaaS | Payment Only After Success ## URGENT — Meta Business Verification & App Review Expert Needed for WERO Chat **100% SUCCESS-BASED PAYMENT — NO UPFRONT FEES** We are urgently looking for a highly experienced Meta Business Verification, Meta App Review, WhatsApp Business API, and Instagram Messaging API specialist who can help us obtain official Meta approval as quickly as possible. We are only interested in professionals with proven experience in resolving difficult Meta verification and application approval cases. ### 1. About Our Company Our company operates under the brand **WERO Chat**, an AI-powered SaaS platform for customer communication automation. Our business is legally registered in **Tajikistan as an Individual Entrepreneur (Sole Proprietorship)**. Our official registration documents contain the legal name of the individual entrepreneur, while WERO Chat is our commercial product and brand name. We need someone who understands how Meta verifies sole proprietors and businesses registered outside the United States and European Union. ### 2. Our Current Problem We have already submitted our business information and verification documents to Meta multiple times. Unfortunately: • Our Meta Business Verification has been rejected repeatedly. • The verification and approval process has taken a significant amount of time. • Meta's rejection messages have not provided sufficiently clear or actionable explanations. • We have tried correcting our information and resubmitting documents, but the problem remains unresolved. • This is preventing us from launching important WhatsApp and Instagram integrations for our SaaS customers. We cannot afford to continue losing weeks or months on unsuccessful submissions. **We urgently need a specialist who can identify the exact problem and find the fastest legitimate solution.** ### 3. About WERO Chat WERO Chat is a multi-tenant AI-powered customer communication platform. It allows businesses to manage messages from multiple communication channels in one dashboard. Our integrations include: • WhatsApp Business Platform • Instagram Messaging API • Facebook Messenger • Telegram • Website live chat Each business must be able to connect and manage its own WhatsApp Business and Instagram accounts. Our platform is designed to support: • 10 companies initially • 100 companies as we grow • 500+ companies in the future We need an official, secure, scalable integration that supports multiple independent business customers. ### 4. What We Need You to Do **A. Resolve Meta Business Verification** Review our existing Meta Business Portfolio, identify the reasons for repeated verification rejections, and help us successfully complete verification as an Individual Entrepreneur registered in Tajikistan. **B. Obtain Meta App Review Approval** Help us obtain the required WhatsApp Business Platform and Instagram Messaging API permissions, including Advanced Access where necessary. Prepare the required documentation, screencast demonstrations, reviewer instructions, and application submissions. **C. Enable Multi-Client SaaS Integration** Ensure our platform can officially onboard external businesses using the appropriate WhatsApp Embedded Signup and Instagram authorization flows. **D. Find the Fastest Official Solution** We are especially interested in alternative official integration methods that can help us launch faster. If direct Meta App Review approval is difficult or time-consuming, investigate whether we can legally integrate through an existing approved Meta Tech Provider or Solution Partner. We are looking for the shortest compliant route to working WhatsApp and Instagram integrations. **E. Avoid Expensive Per-Account Fees** Our SaaS pricing model cannot support expensive fixed monthly fees for every connected WhatsApp or Instagram account. We prefer a solution without recurring per-account platform fees, whenever possible. ### 5. Strict Payment Conditions **IMPORTANT: PAYMENT ONLY AFTER SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION.** Because we have already experienced multiple unsuccessful attempts, we will work only under a success-based payment agreement. Our conditions: 1. No upfront payment. 2. No advance fees. 3. No payments for rejected applications or unsuccessful verification attempts. 4. No payments for consultations that do not result in the agreed approval. 5. Payment will only be released after our own Meta Business Portfolio is successfully verified and the necessary Meta permissions are approved and active for WERO Chat. 6. We must be able to independently verify the approval and successfully connect and test external business accounts. 7. All required permissions must be legitimate, official, and suitable for long-term commercial SaaS operations. 8. Temporary approvals, development-only access, rented Meta accounts, or unauthorized integrations will not count as successful completion. We are willing to fund a fixed-price milestone through the freelance platform's escrow system, with funds released only after the agreed results are independently verified, subject to the platform's payment and dispute rules. **Please do not apply if you require upfront payment or cannot accept these conditions.** ### 6. Requirements for the Freelancer You should have proven experience with: • Meta Business Verification • Meta App Review • WhatsApp Cloud API • Instagram Messaging API • WhatsApp Embedded Signup • Meta Advanced Access permissions • Meta Tech Provider / Solution Partner integrations • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms • Business verification for sole proprietors and companies outside the US/EU We strongly prefer specialists who have successfully resolved repeated Meta verification rejections. ### 7. Questions You Must Answer Please answer the following questions when submitting your proposal: 1. Have you successfully resolved repeated Meta Business Verification rejections? 2. Have you worked with Individual Entrepreneurs (Sole Proprietors) registered in Tajikistan or similar countries? 3. Have you successfully obtained WhatsApp and Instagram API approvals for multi-tenant SaaS platforms? 4. What is the fastest realistic route to approval in our situation? 5. Can you offer a legitimate solution through an existing approved Meta Tech Provider or Solution Partner? 6. Can you provide evidence of previous successful projects? 7. Do you agree to payment only after successful completion and independent verification? 8. What is your total fixed price and estimated completion timeline? ### 8. Security and Access We can provide relevant screenshots, rejection messages, and company registration documentation when necessary. We will grant limited, role-based access to Meta Business assets only when required. We do not share personal Facebook passwords, two-factor authentication codes, recovery codes, or ownership of our Meta Business Portfolio. ### 9. Our Main Goal We need to obtain official, reliable Meta API access for WERO Chat as quickly as possible. Our success criteria are: • Successful Meta Business Verification for our legal business • Approved and active WhatsApp Business API permissions • Approved and active Instagram Messaging API permissions • Ability to connect independent external business customers • Successful testing with real customer accounts • A scalable and compliant SaaS integration architecture • No dependency on rented accounts or unauthorized API access **We are ready to start immediately.** If you have real experience solving complex Meta approval problems and can deliver a verified working solution, please contact us with your proposed approach, previous experience, fixed price, and timeline. **NO APPROVAL = NO PAYMENT, subject to the agreed milestone and freelance platform terms.**

opportunities.description: Tenho uma empresa de serviços que atende tanto clientes residenciais quanto empresariais e, neste momento, preciso transformar os contactos que já chegam pelas minhas redes sociais em visitas ou reuniões presenciais — etapa essencial para fechar contratos. Trabalho diariamente com Instagram, Facebook e WhatsApp, mas sinto que ainda não aproveito todo o potencial dessas plataformas para gerar negócio. O que procuro é uma estratégia prática e mensurável que: • valorize, em equilíbrio, os serviços residenciais e empresariais; • use Instagram, Facebook e WhatsApp de forma integrada para captar e nutrir leads; • conduza cada contacto a marcar uma visita ou reunião, que é o meu principal objetivo; • traga métricas claras de desempenho para que eu possa acompanhar o progresso. Deliverables indispensáveis 1. Diagnóstico inicial das minhas páginas atuais (conteúdo, copy, anúncios e funil de mensagens). 2. Calendário editorial com temas e formatos pensados para ambos os públicos. 3. Scripts de abordagem e follow-up no WhatsApp, Instagram DM e Messenger que maximizem o agendamento da visita/reunião. 4. Plano de anúncios segmentados (quando fizer sentido) indicando públicos, verba sugerida e criativos-modelo. 5. Relatório de métricas e ajustes recomendados após o primeiro ciclo de testes. Aceito sugestões de ferramentas de automação ou CRM leve, desde que se integrem facilmente às plataformas que já uso. Se já tiver casos de sucesso semelhantes, compartilhe; será um diferencial na seleção.

opportunities.title: 15-Second Sea Moss Testimonial
opportunities.description: I’m producing a quick UGC reel that introduces Serene Sea Moss Bitters from the perspective of a client sitting in a hair salon. The clip runs exactly 15 seconds and must feel authentically unscripted—natural and casual, as if the stylist just asked for a quick review. The woman will hold the bottle while she speaks and say, in her own words, that it’s “a simple addition to my beauty and self-care routine.” No influencer polish, no hard sell—just genuine, easygoing enthusiasm. Production flow • Generate the photorealistic female testimonial in Omni Flash at 720p; do not upscale in the generator. • Bring that file into CapCut, upscale to 1080p, and add on-screen captions created through captioniz (open-style captions, centred, brand colour #3FB792). • Keep background audio light—ambient salon sounds are fine, but the voice must remain clear. Please deliver: • Final 1080p MP4, 15 s max, ready for use on TikTok/Reels • Separate SRT of the captions in case we want to tweak colours later • The original 720p Omni Flash render for reference If this first $10 video matches the brief, I’ll need around three similar pieces every week, so think of this as a paid audition for ongoing work.

opportunities.title: 24/7 Low-Risk Crypto Bot
opportunities.description: I want a fully-automated cryptocurrency bot that trades around the clock on the spot market only. Because I do not have a pre-existing system, you will be designing and coding a brand-new strategy whose sole purpose is steady, lower-risk growth—no futures, no leverage, just disciplined buying and selling of regular coins. What I need from you • Craft a rules-based or algorithmic strategy that prioritises capital preservation and consistent gains. • Implement it in a language and framework suited to production use (Python ccxt, Node, Rust, etc.—I’m flexible as long as it is well-supported and maintainable). • Integrate securely with major exchanges such as Binance, Kraken, or Coinbase via API. • Build in risk controls: position sizing, maximum daily drawdown limits, stop-loss logic, and configurable trade filters. • Provide thorough back-testing with clear performance metrics and a short write-up that justifies the strategy’s risk profile. • Deliver clean, well-commented source code plus a README that explains setup, environment variables, and how to deploy so the bot can run 24/7 on a VPS or cloud instance. • Offer at least one live test session to verify everything works with real-time market data. Acceptance criteria 1. Back-test report shows lower drawdowns and a positive return over multiple market conditions. 2. Live demo executes spot trades automatically without manual intervention. 3. All configuration items—including API keys and risk parameters—are externally editable. 4. Full source code and documentation are handed over so I can run, modify, or extend the bot independently. If you have questions about exchange choice, preferred languages, or hosting, let me know—otherwise I’m ready to review your proposed approach and timeline.

opportunities.title: Fix WhatsApp Template Error
opportunities.description: My Meta Business account and all related business details are fully approved, yet the Message Template section inside WhatsApp Manager (within Meta Business Manager) refuses to open. Each time I click on “Message Templates” I am greeted with the generic “Something went wrong or the page cannot be loaded” error, so I cannot even reach the submission form. I need someone who already knows the quirks of Meta Business Suite, WhatsApp Manager, and the underlying API permissions to trace and eliminate whatever is blocking access. Whether the fix involves correcting roles and system users, cleaning mis-configured WhatsApp Business assets, or nudging Meta support through the right channels, the end result I’m after is simple: • The Message Templates page loads normally. • I can submit new templates and they move to “Submitted” without errors. If you have resolved this exact issue before and can jump in immediately, let’s get this sorted today.

opportunities.title: Dummy Flight Ticket Ads Campaign
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a Google Ads specialist who has previously run and scaled dummy flight-ticket campaigns and can replicate that success for my brand. The sole objective is to drive qualified online form submission, WhatsApp messages or direct phone calls from people in India who need a dummy ticket to support their visa application. You’ll receive full access to my current Google Ads account, sample creatives, and the WhatsApp business number. From there, I expect you to: • Build or refine high-intent search and call-only campaigns around keywords such as “dummy ticket for visa”, “flight itinerary for visa”, etc. • Craft persuasive ad copy and extensions that highlight same-day issuance and 24/7 support. • Implement reliable call and WhatsApp click tracking so every enquiry is captured in real time. • Optimise bids, audiences, and negative keywords daily to keep the cost per lead low while scaling volume. • Provide concise weekly reports summarising impressions, clicks, cost, enquiries received, and actionable next steps. Past results with comparable visa-related ticket offers are essential; please share screenshots or case studies showing lead volume and CPL you achieved. If you’re confident you can turn searchers into callers quickly, let’s get started right away.

opportunities.title: PDF Tables to Excel Sheets -2
opportunities.description: I have a folder full of PDF reports—each one contains the same table layout from page to page. I need a repeat-able way to pull those tables out and drop the data into Excel, with every PDF landing on its own worksheet inside a single workbook. Because the layout never changes, the job is perfect for automation. A Python script using PyPDF2, Camelot, or Tabula-py is fine, and I’m open to Power Query or VBA if you prefer. What matters most is accuracy, zero manual copy-and-paste, and a process I can rerun whenever new PDFs arrive. Acceptance criteria • Script reads every PDF in a chosen folder and recognises the fixed table structure. • Creates/updates one Excel file, naming each worksheet after the source PDF (or a logical alias I can configure). • Preserves column headers exactly as they appear in the PDF. • No data loss, misaligned columns, or merged-cell issues. Deliverables 1. The full, well-commented source code or macro. 2. A sample run using three of my PDFs, showing correct export to separate sheets. 3. A brief read-me explaining setup and how to change the target folder or output path. If you’ve done similar extraction work before, let me know any libraries or techniques you found most reliable so we get this running smoothly on the first pass.

I need a repeat-able way to pull those tables out and drop the data into Excel, with every PDF landing on its own worksheet inside a single workbook. Because the layout never changes, the job is perfect for automation. A Python script using PyPDF2, Camelot, or Tabula-py is fine, and I’m open to Power Query or VBA if you prefer. What matters most is accuracy, zero manual copy-and-paste, and a process I can rerun whenever new PDFs arrive. Acceptance criteria • Script reads every PDF in a chosen folder and recognises the fixed table structure. • Creates/updates one Excel file, naming each worksheet after the source PDF (or a logical alias I can configure). • Preserves column headers exactly as they appear in the PDF. • No data loss, misaligned columns, or merged-cell issues. Deliverables 1. The full, well-commented source code or macro. 2. A sample run using three of my PDFs, showing correct export to separate sheets. 3. A brief read-me explaining setup and how to change the target folder or output path. If you’ve done similar extraction work before, let me know any libraries or techniques you found most reliable so we get this running smoothly on the first pass."

opportunities.title: Founding Business Development Manager Needed
opportunities.description: Webidea is a U.S.-based IT and digital services company. Work directly with our founder to define offers and close U.S. SMB clients for digital marketing, GoHighLevel CRM, and AI-enabled automation. Your Role & Requirements - Own the full sales cycle: prospecting via LinkedIn/networking (no cold calling), discovery calls, proposals, and closing. - We handle delivery; you own commercial strategy and sales. - Must have proven success selling agency/tech services to U.S. businesses, strong English, and availability during U.S. business hours. Compensation: The 90-Day Challenge - Months 1-3 (Performance-First): 25% uncapped commission on collected service fees from your new clients, lasting for their first six months. (Ad spend, taxes, and third-party costs are excluded). - Month 4+ (Retainer Unlocked): Hit your 90-day targets to unlock a fixed monthly retainer. Upon unlocking the base retainer, ongoing commission rates for new deals will transition to our standard 10-15% tier. Milestones to Unlock Your Retainer (8-10 hrs/week) - Day 30: Hold 3-5 qualified discovery meetings and submit initial proposals. - Day 60: Secure your first paying client. - Day 90: Maintain 4-5 paying clients and an active pipeline of qualified opportunities. These are initial targets for an 8–10-hour working week, to be confirmed at kickoff and reviewed against pricing, market feedback, and the sales cycle. Qualified meetings must involve a relevant decision-maker, a clear business need, and a plausible budget and timeframe. These milestones represent our initial performance expectations. We welcome faster progress and stronger results while maintaining client fit, service quality, and profitable pricing. Higher collected service revenue from qualifying deals means higher commission earnings for you under the agreed terms. How to apply Share one relevant offer-building and sales example with your results, your suggested first-month focus, weekly availability, and U.S. time-zone overlap. Start your application with the word "BDM" so we know you read this entirely

opportunities.title: Edición de Reels en CapCut
opportunities.description: Editor/a de CapCut para finalizar reels según el estilo de cada cliente Busco una persona con experiencia en CapCut para finalizar reels de 45 segundos a 1 minuto. Te compartiré el proyecto editable con el montaje base realizado. Según cada video, dejaré preparada la corrección de audio y, cuando corresponda, la capa de ajuste para el color. Esa capa ya estará implementada; solo tendrás que retocar sus detalles si hace falta. Ya existen muchos reels publicados de cada cliente que podrás consultar como referencia. Es importante que los revises con atención para aprender por tu cuenta el estilo de cada marca: su ritmo, sus recursos visuales y su forma de editar. Busco a alguien que aprenda rápido y trabaje con autonomía, sin necesitar instrucciones detalladas para cada video. Tu trabajo será completar y pulir cada reel siguiendo el montaje y el manual de marca del cliente. Esto incluye: - Buscar e integrar imágenes y videos de apoyo que encajen con el contenido y la voz en off. - Organizar y ubicar los efectos de sonido. opportunities.title: B2B Cold Email Automation Overhaul
opportunities.description: I need our entire cold-email operation taken off my plate and rebuilt so messages reliably land in the inbox, follow-ups run on autopilot and every reply is captured without me lifting a finger. The priority is full-cycle management—from list upload and warm-up, through personalised sequences, to routing positive answers back to my sales team. Along the way you’ll diagnose why our current campaigns hit spam folders, fix technical settings (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, rDNS, sending cadence, copy structure) and implement an automation stack that scales with our B2B outreach volumes. When you pitch, please show similar projects you have already completed; past work that proves you can improve deliverability and run ongoing email automation is what I will use to choose the right partner. If you can handle everything from deliverability to replies, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Creación Recetas Pupusas Gourmet
opportunities.description: Quiero darle un giro gourmet al plato típico de las pupusas elaborando sabores nuevos que sigan siendo, ante todo, una celebración de lo tradicional. Mi prioridad es desarrollar recetas inéditas basadas en la mejora de los clásicos salvadoreños: partiremos de queso, frijoles y chicharrón y, a la vez, integraremos loroco, ayote, hierbas locales y proteínas especiales como mariscos, pollo o cortes selectos de carne. Necesito tu apoyo para: • Diseñar al menos seis recetas finales que sorprendan al paladar sin perder su identidad. • Incluir por cada receta una ficha técnica clara (gramajes, procesos, tiempos, costos estimados y sugerencia de salsas o maridaje). • Proponer la presentación visual de cada pupusa para que luzca atractiva en el menú. Te entregaré retroalimentación rápida; probaremos las versiones en mi propia cocina hasta afinar texturas y sabores. Acepto cualquier formato de trabajo (Word, Excel, PDF) siempre que sea comprensible para mi equipo. Al finalizar, quiero un recetario digital listo para producción y una tabla de costos por unidad.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40793918, publicado hace 15 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: Comercial B2B para SaaS Clínico
opportunities.description: Comercial freelance B2B para software de clínicas – España | Colaboración a comisión Buscamos un/a comercial freelance o agente comercial autónomo para colaborar en la comercialización de soluciones SaaS de gestión dirigidas a clínicas veterinarias y dentales en España. Se trata de aplicaciones ya desarrolladas y operativas, con demostraciones online disponibles para los candidatos seleccionados. Funciones del colaborador: * Identificar clínicas potencialmente interesadas. * Contactar con responsables y presentar las soluciones. * Realizar demostraciones comerciales online. * Gestionar consultas, seguimiento y negociación. * Cerrar nuevas contrataciones. Qué ofrecemos: * Productos SaaS operativos con suscripciones de 49 a 79 €/mes. * Colaboración flexible y a distancia. * Remuneración exclusivamente mediante comisiones por clientes contratados y pagos efectivamente cobrados. * Sin cuotas fijas ni remuneración por horas. * Material comercial y apoyo técnico para resolver dudas. * Posibilidad de colaboración estable a largo plazo. Perfil buscado: * Experiencia en ventas B2B en España. * Preferiblemente conocimientos o contactos en el sector veterinario, dental o sanitario. * Se valorará especialmente disponer de cartera propia de clínicas. * Capacidad para gestionar el ciclo comercial completo, desde la prospección hasta el cierre. Proceso de selección: En una primera fase valoraremos la experiencia comercial, los sectores en los que trabaja cada candidato y su disponibilidad para colaborar a comisión. A los perfiles preseleccionados se les facilitará información sobre la marca y acceso a las demostraciones públicas para que puedan evaluar el producto por sí mismos. Buscamos una colaboración basada en resultados, no servicios de publicidad, campañas de marketing ni únicamente generación de contactos. Importante: el presupuesto indicado en la plataforma es orientativo. La remuneración se negociará por comisiones sobre ventas efectivamente cobradas, respetando las condiciones de contratación y pago de Freelancer.

opportunities.title: Vendedor Online de Perfumería
opportunities.description: Necesitamos incorporar a nuestro equipo, personas que se encargue de las ventas de perfumes originales de marcas reconocidas, gestionando los canales de WhatsApp, redes sociales y teléfono. Tu día a día incluirá: • Publicar contenido atractivo y promociones en redes sociales para mantener el interés y generar nuevas oportunidades de venta. • Dar seguimiento a prospectos y clientes hasta concretar cada venta, registrando el avance en un reporte simple que me permita medir resultados. Valoramos la proactividad para proponer ideas, manejar objeciones y cerrar ventas de ticket medio-alto. Experiencia previa en perfumería o cosmética será un plus, pero lo que más cuenta es la habilidad de comunicar beneficios y crear confianza desde el primer mensaje. Entrego catálogo, precios y lineamientos de marca; tú aportarás creatividad, constancia y orientación a resultados. Si disfrutas el trato directo con clientes y buscas crecer vendiendo productos de lujo ampliamente conocidos, nos encantará conocerte.

opportunities.title: Need to attend a conference in Rome on my behalf
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a freelancer to attend a conference in Rome, Italy, on my behalf. The primary goal of this assignment is to showcase our product. This is a lead generation strategy to bring for future clients. Your responsibilities will include showing the banner to the mass of people present at the event. Who is interested in our product? Just ask to scan the Telegram/WhatsApp/Teams QR given on the banner. Our backend team will be available on those handles, and they will take them forward. The main aim is establishing connections that could lead to future business opportunities. We are looking for a local freelancer in Rome, Italy. who can attend a conference on behalf of our company. You have to take snaps during the event. The conference will be for 2 days; just enjoy the time and have fun. The conference is on 3rd & 4th November 2026. At the end we want the snap you have taken, and a report on the event should be sent by email. The format of the report will be given by us. A person should be frank enough and have good communication. Key tasks include: - Actively networking with potential clients - Distributing prepared networking materials (business cards and brochures) Ideal skills for this job include: - Strong communication and interpersonal skills - Experience in business networking - Ability to represent a company professionally If you have potential and you are interested, please send me a message so that we can discuss... We can also associate for post-event activity also; if performance is great, we can appoint you as country manager further.

opportunities.title: Prospección y Ventas vía WhatsApp
opportunities.description: Busco un profesional enfocado en ventas y atención al cliente que domine las conversaciones por teléfono y, sobre todo, por WhatsApp. Objetivo • Detectar y contactar nuevos prospectos cada día. • Presentar de forma clara nuestros productos o servicios, resolviendo dudas y generando confianza. • Mantener un flujo continuo de información sobre leads, avances y cierres para que podamos medir resultados y optimizar el guion. Qué necesito de tu parte – Experiencia demostrable en ventas telefónicas o vía WhatsApp. – Habilidad para investigar, segmentar y generar tu propia lista inicial de potenciales clientes o aprovechar la base de datos que te proporcionaré. – Capacidad para adaptar el discurso según el tipo de cliente y registrar cada interacción en un sencillo CRM o en una hoja de cálculo compartida. – Seguimiento post-presentación hasta encaminar el cierre o concertar una cita con mi equipo. Entregables esperados 1. Listado semanal de contactos abordados con estado de cada conversación. 2. Reporte de ventas cerradas o citas agendadas. 3. Recomendaciones breves para mejorar guiones, objeciones frecuentes y próximos pasos. Si cuentas con un enfoque proactivo, tino comercial y gusto por abrir mercado, me encantará conocer tu propuesta y la estrategia que aplicarías durante el primer mes.
